query: summarize the v0.30 OAuth provider changes

seed_memories.content: To summarize the v0.30 OAuth provider changes: rein added a built-in OAuth 2.0 provider with explicit auth policy (loopback_only / bearer_required / oauth / public), authorization-code flow with PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, SQLite-backed clients and grants, and signed metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.
seed_memories.summary: Summarize of v0.30 OAuth provider changes: policy, PKCE, DCR, and .well-known.
